typography.notes: Use `tracking-tight` for large headings (H1/H2). Use wide letter-spacing (`tracking-[0.2em]`) for uppercase overlines and labels. Combine `font-light` or `font-normal` (Playfair) for elegance with `font-medium` (Outfit) for readable body text. Never use generic fonts for headings.

colors.notes: Palette: White, Gold (#D4AF37), Deep Navy (#0A192F), Soft Black (#111111). Deep Navy and Soft Black are used for high-end cinematic base and footers. Gold for luxury accents and subtle borders. White for spacious content sections. WhatsApp CTA must be unmistakable Green (#25D366).

layouts.hero: Cinematic full-screen (`min-h-screen`) with a dark overlay (`bg-black/40` to `bg-black/50`). Use Framer Motion for a masked line-by-line text reveal on load.
layouts.bento_grid: For Highlights and 'Why Book With Us', avoid generic equal squares. Use an asymmetric 'Tetris' Grid (e.g., mixing `col-span-12 md:col-span-8` and `col-span-4`) to create visual tension and editorial feel.
layouts.spacing: Extremely generous. Sections must have `py-24` or `py-32` to breathe. Container widths should max out at `max-w-7xl` with `px-6` or `px-8`.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used for the sticky Attention Bar, Lead Capture floating elements, and Trust Bar. Needs high-end blur: `backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/10` (over dark) or `bg-white/80` (over light) with a delicate 1px `border-white/20` inside.
visual_enhancers.animations: Lenis for smooth scroll (momentum scrolling). Framer Motion `whileInView` for staggered reveals. Slow editorial marquee (`react-fast-marquee`) for reviews.
visual_enhancers.borders: Avoid heavy shadows. Use 1px solid borders in Gold/Navy with low opacity (`border-black/5` or `border-[#D4AF37]/30`) to define edges crisply.
visual_enhancers.3d_parallax: Implement a subtle parallax effect on the hero background and perhaps float some elements gently.

components.name: Attention Bar
components.instruction: Sticky at the top (`z-[60]`). Dark Navy or Soft Black background, Gold text. Must include an animated countdown timer. Text: '🔥 LIMITED TIME OFFER — SAVE UP TO 30% OFF — Limited Seats • Limited Time Only'.

components.name: Hero Section
components.instruction: Full screen cinematic. Background MUST be a looping HTML5 video (or a high-res cinematic snow mountain image if video unavailable). Overlay: 'Explore Kashmir in Luxury — 6 Days / 5 Nights Super Deluxe Package — Starting from just ₹9,800 per person — Luxury Hotels • Houseboat • Shikara Ride • Daily Meals • Private Cab'. Two large CTAs: 'Book on WhatsApp' (Green) and 'Call Now' (White/Gold outline). Includes signature on-load moment (masked line-by-line reveal).

components.name: Floating WhatsApp Button
components.instruction: Fixed bottom right (`z-50`). Should have a subtle pulse animation and a glassmorphism tooltip saying 'Chat with an Expert'.

components.name: Trust Bar
components.instruction: Horizontal bar directly below hero. Icons + Text: 5-star rating, Local Kashmir Experts, No Hidden Charges, Instant Confirmation, 24x7 Support.

components.name: Package Highlights Cards
components.instruction: Premium icon cards in an asymmetric grid. 3 Star Super Deluxe Hotels, Daily Buffet Breakfast & Dinner, Private Cab, Complimentary 1 Hour Shikara Ride, Sonamarg, Gulmarg, Pahalgam, Srinagar Houseboat Stay.

components.name: Itinerary Timeline
components.instruction: Vertical layout. A beautiful scroll-linked timeline line connecting Day 1 to Day 6. Deeply interactive, revealing day details as the user scrolls.

components.name: Pricing Cards
components.instruction: Luxury pricing presentation. Do not use generic SaaS pricing cards. Use editorial presentation for: Couple ₹32,300, Group of 5 ₹9,800pp, Group of 6 ₹10,700pp, Group of 9 'Best Value' ₹10,400pp, Budget from ₹8,000pp. Highlight 'Best Value' with a Gold border/glow.

components.name: Reviews Marquee
components.instruction: Animated Google-style reviews. Slow drifting marquee. Clean, glass-like cards with 5 gold stars.

components.name: Lead Capture Form
components.instruction: High-contrast section. Fields: Full Name, Phone, Number of Guests, Travel Month. Submit buttons: 'Get Instant Quote' + 'Call Now' (redirect to WA). Must feel highly secure and premium.

hero_fallback.description: Dramatic snow mountain peak (Himalayas) for the hero background poster or fallback.

instructions_to_main_agent: Construct the page with ONE goal: maximize WhatsApp/Phone leads. No main navigation menu, no footer links except privacy/terms.
Use HTML/Tailwind for the landing page structure to allow extreme layout flexibility and asymmetry, bypassing restrictive UI card components where art direction is needed.
Use Shadcn UI for the Lead Capture Form, Select, Accordion (FAQ), and Toasts.
Apply `data-testid` to all CTAs, form inputs, accordion items, and the attention bar.
Ensure 'Book on WhatsApp' buttons redirect to `https://wa.me/917006186445`.
Implement Lenis smooth scrolling inside `App.js` or main layout.
Use `framer-motion` extensively for scroll reveals and the hero staggered text animation.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Never apply universal transition (e.g., `transition: all`). This breaks framer-motion transforms.
Do NOT use `text-align: center` on the global App container.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels normal. Luxury requires white space.
Ensure all text meets APCA/WCAG contrast ratios against backgrounds, especially over images.
Avoid generic, AI-slop layouts. Every component should feel deliberately designed.
Use layered z-indexes to build depth (background, particles, glass overlay, content).
All interactive elements MUST have visible, stylized hover/focus states.
DO NOT use generic emojis for icons. Use a proper icon library (e.g. lucide-react).
